julia (sales): Quick follow-up from AH: multiple customers asked why we lost deals last quarter. Can leadership share concise themes so Sales can update playbooks?

sam (ceo): Short themes: pilot speed, named support during onboarding, and clear perf guarantees. Not price.

anya (product): Noted. Proposed immediate actions: 1) 1-page 'why we win/lose' for reps, 2) pilot SLA template + named POC process, 3) brief quantization-quality guide.

eli (cs): CS will draft the pilot SLA language and a checklist for named-POC handoffs. ETA: 4 business days.

maya (eng-infra): I can produce a minimal on-prem image + deployment checklist for pilots. ETA: 10 days for MVP.

julia (sales): Great — I need the 1-pager and the SLA text to share in calls. Can we get a quick sync to assign owners?

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: "Customer loss -> playbook sync" Wed 09:30 15m 16 attendees: Sam, Anya, Julia, Eli, Maya.

sam (ceo): Let's keep the sync focused on owners and deadlines. Thanks everyone.
_meta: generated for dataset: all-hands Q&A about customer wins/losses and feedback loops
